newsitem.title: UK: Carr's Milling chairman Carr to retire.
newsitem.headline: Carr's Milling chairman Carr to retire.

text.p: British food and engineering firm Carr's Milling Industries Plc said on Tuesday that Ian Carr would be standing down on September 1, after some 33 years as chairman of the company.
The company said David Newton, 54, would take over as non-executive chairman at the beginning of September.
Newton, a former chief executive of Hillsdown Holdings Plc, joined the Carr's board last April.
Carr, 68, will remain as non-executive vice chairman until August 1998. Chris Holmes will stay on as chief executive, the company said in a statement.
